chapters.title: When and where the event takes place
chapters.body_html:
Date

The event runs on 20–23 Aug 2026 (Thursday to Sunday). Thursday is arrival and registration day, Friday is the accompanying programme (fair, arenas, registration), Saturday is the main battle, Sunday is clean-up and departure.

Location

A meadow between the town of Křtiny and the village of Bukovina (South Moravia).

  • GPS: 49.29895232776445, 16.759155153131733
  • Map: open in Google Maps

Detailed travel instructions (car, bus, on foot) are in the How to get to us section.

Registration

  • Registration runs through the external Registračka.cz system.
  • You need to create an account, fill in your personal data and sign up for a specific event. The data only needs to be filled in the first time.
  • The exact link for the 2026 edition will be published by 15 May 2026.
  • Registration runs in waves. Once one army fills up, the limits are raised further.
  • Details on the Registration page.
The date and location are fixed per CLAUDE.md (source of truth). Some programme details are still being clarified — keep an eye on this page; registered participants will also receive an e-mail.

chapters.title: Who the event is for and what to bring (documents)
chapters.body_html:
Age limits

  • The event is intended for playing participants over 12 years. For younger children there is a separate children's game.
  • Participants under 18 must hand in a completed and signed Application for players under 18 at registration.
  • Persons under 15 may take part only in the company of a person over 18 who is responsible for them (parent/legal guardian). Without a signed permit we will not let them in.
  • Children under 12 are at all times the responsibility of their parents.

Required documents

Each player must have:

  • health insurance card,
  • ID card.
  • The player may be asked to present them at registration.
  • Participants from abroad (incl. Slovakia) present proof of health insurance.
  • If you arrive by car, print and fill in the Parking card and place it behind the windscreen (see How to get to us).
Without a printed, properly filled-in and legally signed application participants under 18 will not be allowed into the battle. The current PDF of the application will be added once the 2026 registration system is finalised.

Quick „what to bring" checklist

Player
  • costume
  • weapon / weapons (better more — see Weapons)
  • gloves (protect fingers)
  • canteen or container for water
  • insurance card + ID
  • own medication
  • snack, your own drink
  • suitable neutral footwear (no yellow-and-white sneakers)
  • own mug and bowl (plastic will be charged)
  • camping gear (tent, sleeping bag, …)
Under 18 + driver
  • signed application from the legal guardian
  • insurance card
  • medication + instructions for the medic
  • Under 15: an 18+ companion
  • — for drivers —
  • parking card behind the windscreen
  • patience on the dusty road
  • respect for the organisers' instructions

chapters.title: Event programme — schedule
chapters.body_html:
The main framework of the 2026 edition (exact times will be specified in the week before the event):

Day What's happening
Thu 20 AugArrival of participants and event registration. After dusk a large fire and a guitar session.
Fri 21 AugAccompanying programme: Spread Blanket (bazaar/flea market), vendor fair, arenas (1v1, 5v5, „Randomiser", archery); registration and weapon approvals continue. In the evening, campfires, music and fun. Lights out at 23:30.
Sat 22 AugMain battle. Wake-up at 8:00, roll-call and rules explanation plus breakfast (without costumes) at 8:30. Registration, weapon approval and getting into costume from 9:00 to 10:30. Calling-out of armies at 10:30, the ruler's fifteen-minute moment of glory from 10:45 to 11:00. Main battle from 11:00 until about 16:00–17:00, with a lunch break between 13:00 and 14:00.
Sun 23 AugCamp clean-up, packing, departure. In the afternoon, an after-party with the organisers — whoever stays helps and chats.

Friday programme in more detail

  • Spread Blanket — all-day bazaar / flea market with gear. Under a shelter next to registration.
  • Fair — vendors of thematic gear (see Stalls and vendors).
  • Arenas — starting around 15:00 depending on the number of participants: 1v1 combat arena, 5v5, „Randomiser", 1v1 archery arena. Sign up at registration.
  • People, campfires, music — fires 50 m from the forest (marked) and only after the organiser's approval. A spade/shovel is available at the org tent.
The exact times for Friday's registration (from when to when) will be added about two weeks before the event. Saturday's times are fixed.

chapters.title: Camping and conduct in the camp
chapters.body_html:
The camping rules (fire, smoking, alcohol, quiet hours, litter) are described in detail in Rules → Participation in the event and conduct in the camp. Here is a quick summary:

  • Whatever the organiser says goes. The organiser's word cannot be circumvented.
  • The costume requirement applies throughout the entire event — even outside the battle and for companions.
  • Quiet hours apply from 22:00 on Friday in the camp and surrounding area.
  • Fires only in approved fire pits. Your own fire pit is allowed only with the organiser's approval. Portable fire pits and grills are OK if they don't damage the lawn.
  • Wood only from supplies brought in or by collecting fallen wood. No felling.
  • Smoking is forbidden throughout the entire game area. In camp, by the fire, it's OK if no one minds.
  • Alcohol/intoxicating substances: anyone under the influence will not be allowed into the battle. A strict ban applies during the battle.
  • After the event, only flattened grass should remain on the meadow. No holes from stakes, no unburied fire pits, no scattered litter.
  • No means no. Respect the personal limits of every participant. A trusted support person will be present at the event.

What will be provided on site

Will be
  • portable toilets (toi-toi)
  • drinking water in a tank
  • pub (see Food and drink)
  • firewood
  • medic for the whole time
Not guaranteed
  • mobile phone signal
  • electrical sockets
  • a water source for bathing

chapters.title: Pub, food and drink
chapters.body_html:
The organisers do not provide full catering. Everyone takes care of their own meals as best they can. To make it easier, on site there will be:

  • a tank with drinking water,
  • an arranged pub,
  • a sweet breakfast before the roll-call,
  • a snack during Saturday's battle.

U Zeleného draka

The pub is provided for you by the U Zeleného draka crew: Ondřej Teplý (Flejm), Tobiáš Tyc (Mýval), Matouš Frič (Střevo).

The pub area will be expanded to 3 large tents forming an enclosed space. There will also be a central campfire and other facilities.

What to bring

  • Your own mug and bowl. Plastic dishes will be charged so the meadow isn't littered with cups.
  • Your own snack.
  • Your own drink if you want something other than water (e.g. cold green tea).

chapters.title: How to get to us (car, bus, on foot)
chapters.body_html:
Venue: a meadow between the town of Křtiny and the village of Bukovina (South Moravia).

GPS coordinates
49.29895232776445, 16.759155153131733
Open in Google Maps

By car — via Bukovina (recommended)

From Brno, head towards Ochoz u Brna. Continue to the village of Březina, where you stay on the main road (do not turn off to Křtiny). Drive through the whole village; then come the switchbacks and you reach a T-junction. Turn right towards Bukovina.

In Bukovina you reach a square with a bus stop. Just beyond it there is a turn to the left — take it. The road leads behind the houses; behind the last house it turns left and continues as a paved road into the fields. You pass an agricultural cooperative (on the left) and silage pits (on the right). Keep going.

When you come to the next turn on the right, you're there. Drive straight across the intersection onto the meadow and park in the parking area.

By car — via Křtiny (alternative, harder)

The route via Křtiny is a bit harder on the car. In Křtiny, orient yourself by the church in the middle of the town. Stand so that the church is behind you (on the left the municipal office, on the right the U Farlíků Inn — direction Brno). The very first turn on the left leads straight uphill — take that one.

The hill is long and quite steep; we recommend a reasonable run-up. Continue straight, don't turn off anywhere (even if another road looks better). On the right you pass garages, on the left cottages. In some places watch out for the chassis.

After a while you reach the edge of the meadow. Don't turn onto the meadow right away — drive further along the forest on the same road. At a T-junction where the road turns left into a tree-lined alley, you're there. Turn onto the meadow right here and park.

  • Print and place behind the windscreen the Parking card (PDF will be added).
  • On the dusty road max. 15–20 km/h, preferably less.
  • Park exactly according to the organisers' instructions on the meadow near the camp (about 5 minutes' walk).

By bus

Key bus stops: Křtiny, municipal office · Bukovina · Bukovina, junction.

Arrival in Křtiny

A simpler option with minimal transfers, but with a hill ahead that will test your fitness. Get off at any stop and stand so that the church is behind you. In front of you is the main road towards Brno, and just a little way along it there's a turn to the left climbing steeply upwards. That one.

Keep going up the hill until you reach the large meadow where we camp. The destination is at the T-junction. The path is marked by arrows on the trees.

Arrival in Bukovina

From Brno this is more complicated — you'll need to change. Get off at the Bukovina, junction stop, cross the road and wait for the bus to Bukovina (one stop).

In Bukovina, after getting off, walk back a little in the direction you came from to a small square with an old bus turning loop. From there, take the paved road to the right between the houses. Follow it until it bends to the left up a small slope, then continues until it turns into a field path. You'll pass the agricultural cooperative and silage pits, then go straight on to the T-junction. Destination.

On foot from the Junction (more adventurous)

For those who don't shy away from walking off the marked trail — an unmarked path directly from the Bukovina, junction bus stop.

Set off on foot towards Bukovina, but not too far. You'll pass a small wood by the road on your left. At its far end (closer to Bukovina) a path turns into the forest — S. K. Neumann's Path, Cyril and Methodius Trail. A more detailed description would spoil the adventure. Red is now your colour.

By air

We're sorry. We didn't manage to convince air traffic control that Nazgûl mounts can be considered civilian aircraft. So you can't get to us by air.

chapters.title: For parents
chapters.body_html:
If your child has convinced you that they want to attend the Pán Prstenů — Battle for Middle-earth LARP, there's no need to worry. The battle is being prepared by people experienced with similar events under the auspices of the Moravian LARP, z. s. association.

Safety

  • Emphasis on safety during registration, costume and weapon approval and during the battle itself.
  • In combat we use non-metal (mostly wooden) replicas of medieval weapons with a padded surface (foam, foam mat). Details in Rules → Weapons.
  • Apart from minor scrapes and bruises, we rarely see more serious injuries at events like this.
  • Throughout the event, a qualified medic with equipment for immediate treatment is present on site.

What a participant under 18 must have

  • a signed Application for players under 18,
  • insurance card,
  • a supply of fluids (there's water on the battlefield, but cold green tea is more refreshing),
  • a snack to replenish energy (muesli bars and the like).

Medication and health restrictions

If your child cannot go without medication (asthma, allergies), make sure they actually have it with them. Report this at registration to the medic, who will be near the registration desk.

Accompanying a child

If you plan to accompany your child, you can watch their efforts in the battle without worry — from a reasonable distance, so that some heroic warrior doesn't mistake you for an opponent.

If you wear natural, non-distracting colours, or at least a hint of a costume (a simple tunic or cloak), you'll help eliminate 21st-century elements that disrupt the atmosphere.

For participants under 15, accompaniment by a legal guardian is mandatory.

Weather

The battle takes place in any weather. An overcast sky is no reason not to come.

Contact

  • E-mail: info@panprstenu.cz
  • E-mail: mealtiner@moravianlarp.cz
  • Phone: 606 369 997 (Mealtiner)

chapters.title: Photo, video and media
chapters.body_html:
We understand that you'd like to take nice photos or videos at the event. We have a few basic rules.

  • The game and the players always come first. If you want a better shot, you must not get in the way or disturb the players.
  • Equipment is at your own risk. The organisers cannot guarantee it against damage or loss.
  • The costume requirement applies to photographers and camera operators too.
  • Safety during the game: the game is dynamic and moves quickly. If you find yourself between fighters, press against the nearest tree, protect your equipment with your body and wait for the game to move on.
  • Consent and commercial use: participants have given consent for photos to be taken for the organisers. For your own commercial use, obtain permission from everyone who appears in the shots.
  • On the other hand, we'll be glad if after the event you share the photos with us for promoting the event.
Drones may be used only after prior agreement with the organisers and only at moments selected by them, in compliance with currently valid legislation.

Official photographers

We have official photographers arranged for the event. You don't have to worry that there won't be any photos. If you don't have to take photos, come and enjoy the event directly, not just through the viewfinder.

For journalists

If you're a journalist and want to write about the event, get in touch in advance at info@panprstenu.cz for accreditation.

chapters.title: Stalls and vendors (fair)
chapters.body_html:
On site we allow the participation of vendors of thematic gear (costumes, fabrics, weapons, leather goods, tablet-woven bands, armour and more). The stalls will be located next to the small square.

For participants

  • The organisers do not ensure or guarantee that on site you'll find every item and every vendor.
  • If you need a specific item from a specific seller, arrange it directly with them in advance.

For vendors

  • Contact us in advance at info@panprstenu.cz.
  • Fill in a short form (the link will be sent as a reply to your e-mail).
  • Register for the event as a non-playing participant and pay the registration fee.
  • From the organisers you can expect a place for a stall and basic facilities. Everything else is up to you.
Regulars (list to be updated for 2026)
  • Linea obchod — natural fabrics (linen, cotton, wool, silk, hemp), home textiles, leather.
  • ZZ Armoury — swords, sabres, arrows, shields, belts, belt-bags, bracers, quivers.
  • Baldonovo brašnářství — leather accessories, belts, bags, sheaths and pouches.
  • Sněděná Karkulka — handwoven tablet-woven goods (straps, belts).
  • Luboš Vostek — furs, bracers, bronze/brass kettles, tin tableware, blankets, wooden chests.
  • Saracénovo veteštnictví — jewellery made of wood, bone and antler.
  • František Šín — minerals and jewellery made from them.
  • Lesklý věcičky — handmade tinned jewellery and accessories with minerals.

chapters.title: I want to help with the preparation
chapters.body_html:
We'll be glad if you spend the whole week with us, or help with at least part of the event.

What helpers get

  • lots of fun,
  • food and drink provided,
  • an exemption from the costume requirement during work tasks,
  • the gratitude of the entire organising crew.

When help is needed

  • Event preparation — Monday 17 Aug – Wednesday 19 Aug 2026 (building facilities, preparing the game area, transporting equipment).
  • During the event — registration, approvals, pub, logistics, coordination of the children's game.
  • Sunday clean-up — Sunday afternoon, 23 Aug 2026 (packing up, cleaning the meadow, transporting equipment, after-party).

How to sign up

Write to info@panprstenu.cz with the subject „I want to help" and, in a short message, tell us when you have time and what you enjoy doing.

chapters.title: Children's game
chapters.body_html:
Children's game — quick info

Age: 5–9 years

Date: Friday 21 Aug 2026

Location: separate zone in the campsite

Accompaniment: parent or legal guardian, 18+

More about the children's game →

Questions and sign-ups: info@panprstenu.cz

For younger participants (5–9 years) we run a separate children's game. It takes place apart from the main battle and is adapted to children's age, safety and abilities.

Who the children's game is for

  • Children aged 5–9 years.
  • Children 9–12 years may attend as non-playing companions / helpers of the children's game — always accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
  • The main game (battle) is for ages 12 and up. Between 12 and 18 a written consent of the legal guardian is required (see Documents).

When and where the children's game takes place

  • Friday 21 Aug 2026 as part of the supporting programme.
  • A separate play zone in the campsite, away from the main battlefield.
  • Under the supervision of a children's-game coordinator and the medic.

What a child needs

  • a simple costume (tunic, cloak, belt — even a hint is enough),
  • sturdy footwear suitable for meadow and forest,
  • their own drink (water bottle) and a snack,
  • a raincoat and warm clothing (the weather can be changeable),
  • health-insurance card kept by the parent,
  • any medication they take — notify the medic.

How to sign up

Children are signed up by their parent / legal guardian directly on site at registration. If you'd like, you can announce your attendance in advance at info@panprstenu.cz — it helps us plan capacity.

For parents of children aged 5–9

The children's game is a standalone programme, not a simplified version of the main battle. Children experience their own story and tasks appropriate to their age. Throughout, they are supervised by adult organisers and within reach of the medic.

chapters.title: Registration and payment — quick overview
chapters.body_html:
Three steps from a decision to a binding reservation. Find the details on the separate Registration and payment page.

The registration fee depends on the date of registration and on age. Children, families and international participants have their own price category. Full prices and conditions are listed below or on the Registration and payment page.

Documents to download

Fill in, print and bring with you. For participants under 18, the legal guardian's consent is mandatory — without it you can't play.

Player application 2026 →Legal guardian's consent →Parking card →

Questions? Write to info@panprstenu.cz.

1. Registration
Online via Registračka.cz

Account, personal details, choice of army. About 10 minutes.

2. Payment
Instructions within 10 days

Payment turns the reservation binding.

3. Cancellation
Until 10 Aug = 100 % back

If you cancel later, the registration fee is non-refundable — but you can arrange a transfer with another player.

→ Registration details, GDPR and payment

More about the registration fee

  • Registration opens on 18 May 2026 at 12:00.
  • First pricing window 18 May – 30 June 2026 = first-minute offer. For players 850 CZK, for participants from Slovakia and abroad ±36.20 €.
  • Second pricing window 1 July – 17 August 2026. For players 950 CZK, from abroad ±40.40 €.
  • Late registration from 18 August 2026 and on-site payment. For players 1 100 CZK, from abroad ±46.80 €.
  • For non-playing and non-combat companions (atmospheric characters, standard-bearers, photographers, escorts): 650 CZK / ±27.60 € until 30 June; 750 CZK / ±31.90 € from 1 July to 17 August; 950 CZK / ±40.40 € from 18 August and on site.
  • Note: If you register on, say, 28 June but pay on 5 July, you'll already be charged the higher registration fee.
  • Note: The registration fee in euros is converted at the current rate. Prices may vary slightly and may be affected by your bank's fees.

Children's and family pricing

  • Children up to and including 4 years pay no registration fee, but must be registered through Registračka as "associated persons" within the non-playing category.
  • Children aged 5–12 years receive a discount — 400 CZK / 17 € as participants outside the children's game.
  • Children aged 5–12 can also take part in the children's game. The registration fee is then 600 CZK / 25.50 €. The children's game must be signed up for through the registration form.
  • Children aged 12 and up are considered regular participants. The main game is 12+. The standard fees above apply to them.

Family discount

  • Maximum family registration fee from 18 May to 30 June 2026: 2 500 CZK / 106.40 €.
  • Maximum family registration fee from 1 July to 17 August 2026: 2 750 CZK / 117.00 €.
  • Maximum family registration fee from 18 August and on-site payment: 2 900 CZK / 123.40 €.
  • The family rate applies to two adults and all their children, registered together under one account on Registračka as "associated persons".
  • The family rate is set as a maximum. If the sum of normal registrations is lower, the lower sum applies.
What may still change

The exact link for the 2026 edition will be published by 15 May 2026. Registration runs in waves — once one army fills up, the limits expand further.
